title: Play and Pause
description: Bấm, tam giác phát tách thành hai khối rồi biến dáng thành hai thanh tạm dừng trong 0.35 s; bấm lại thì về hình tam giác.

moworks.notes: Circle r54 button. Play = two quads: left (140,66) (168,80) (168,116) (140,130) and right (168,80) (196,98) (196,98) (168,116). Pause = two bars 18x64 at x 136 and 166 (y 66-130). Each vertex lerps to its partner over 0.4-0.75 s (350 ms) power2.inOut; reverse 1.75-2.1 s. Vertex dots flash mid-morph (teaching aid, optional). Label PLAY → PAUSE. Params: duration (0.35 s) · ease (power2.inOut) · size (64 px cao). The triangle is two quads whose vertices each move to a partner on the two bars.
